newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 1.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Friday:

* Israeli television and radio reported that the government had threatened to send commandos into Palestinian areas and had decreed a series of severe punitive measures against the Palestinian authority in response to Wednesday's bombing in Jerusalem.
* The tax bill passed by Congress includes many narrowly focused provisions that benefit just a few individuals or businesses.
* In the budget agreement, President Clinton won concessions blunting some of the toughest provisions of last year's welfare bill.

* Two men with Jordanian passports and a third from Egypt were arrested yesterday in a Brooklyn apartment where police found components of one or more pipe bombs, evidence of what authorities say was a plot to detonate bombs in the busy Atlantic Avenue subway station and on a commuter bus.

* Though the state's government has developed a new generosity toward public education, hundreds of already crowded schools in New York City will be hard pressed to use the money as intended while the city contends with a shortage of qualified teachers.
* In the hazily defined inner workings of Russian privatization, fair play is only in the eyes of the winner.
